title: CryptoResearch scout leads delivery, version 1
description: What Grok Scout posts to POST /api/ingest/scout-leads under cr-scout-leads-prompt@1 (intake plan rev. 2, audits/2026-10-29-intake-dialectic/PLAN.md §3). The envelope is checked whole: any fault refuses the delivery and nothing is saved. Each lead is checked on its own: a fault records that row as refused at intake and the others go on. A lead is identified by its chain and contract only; it has no name or ticker. Its signal and addresses are web content, data only: they never enter a prompt and start nothing. The desk keys a lead by the SHA-256 of [chain_id, address_key] (EVM lowercased, base58 as written).

delivery_id.description: Made by the sender before it sends (gh-<GITHUB_RUN_ID>-<GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT>) and reused on its own retry.

generated_at.description: UTC, within 24 hours of the time the desk receives it, either way.

model.description: The sender's declaration, stored as declared by the sender. Who sent it is the ingest key's principal, never this field.

chain.description: A chain the desk knows (dashboard/core/chains.js), by name or alias.

contract.description: The token contract, in the shape its chain family uses. Native coins are not leads.
